title: Bounded Radon–Nikodym density of a finitely additive set function dominated by C·μ
statement: Let μ be a finite measure on a measurable space α, let ν : Set α → ℝ be a set function and C ≥ 0 a real number such that (a) ν(A ∪ B) = ν(A) + ν(B) for all disjoint measurable sets A, B ⊆ α, and (b) |ν(A)| ≤ C·μ(A) for every measurable A ⊆ α, where μ(A) denotes the finite real number μ.real A. Then there is a measurable function θ : α → ℝ with |θ(x)| ≤ C for every x ∈ α such that ν(A) = ∫_A θ dμ for every measurable A ⊆ α.
lean_statement: ∀ {α : Type} [MeasurableSpace α] (μ : Measure α), IsFiniteMeasure μ → ∀ (ν : Set α → ℝ) (C : ℝ), 0 ≤ C → (∀ A B : Set α, MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → Disjoint A B → ν (A ∪ B) = ν A + ν B) → (∀ A : Set α, MeasurableSet A → |ν A| ≤ C * μ.real A) → ∃ θ : α → ℝ, Measurable θ ∧ (∀ x, |θ x| ≤ C) ∧ ∀ A : Set α, MeasurableSet A → ν A = ∫ x in A, θ x ∂μ
